components.text:
Circle: small circle, ritual chalk.

Fills a bottle with Doppelgänger Blood from the owner of the taglock, and tells a player owner whether they carry the gene.

Needs a filled taglock of a doppelgänger villager or of a player who carries the gene (a server can allow any human). The owner must be loaded or online.

A refusal tells the caster why and gives the ingredients back.
